BACKGROUND: Evidence from preclinical studies in small and large animal models 
has shown neuroprotective effects of intravenous administration of umbilical 
cord blood derived cells (UCBCs). This study aimed to evaluate the feasibility 
of umbilical cord blood (UCB) collection, extraction of UCBCs, and subsequent 
safety of intravenous autologous administration of UCBCs in extremely preterm 
infants (born <28 weeks gestation).
